proof.method: Recomputed sha256 of EPUB and PDF as ni URIs and matched stage.json; read all of text/current-epub.txt; spot-checked PDF text (copyright, title page, hyphenation) against it; counted chapters, situations, templates and cross-references; grepped both texts for personal/internal tokens, U+FFFD and Markdown leftovers; unzipped the EPUB and read content.opf; viewed the cover PNG and PDF pages 1 and 3 (pdftoppm 60 dpi); checked pdffonts and pdfinfo; located each fix in the manuscript with grep. Second pass on the restaged edition: recomputed both ni digests and matched the new stage.json; diffed new EPUB text against the r1 text (only the intended changes plus the regenerated edition digest differ); confirmed each fix in both the EPUB and PDF text layers; rescanned for U+FFFD, internal tokens and Markdown leftovers; re-read content.opf; page count still 62.
